newsitem.title: USA: Los Angeles transit agency names interim CEO.
newsitem.headline: Los Angeles transit agency names interim CEO.

text.p: The Los Angeles County Metropolitan Transportation Authority's board of directors on Friday appointed Linda Bohlinger as interim chief executive officer, the authority said.
In a separate move, the board on Friday approved the transfer of $300 million in carpool lane money to help fund the authority's subway project.
Bohlinger will replace Joseph Drew, who recently resigned from the authority but agreed to stay on through January.
Bohlinger will take over the job on February 1. For the past year she has served as deputy chief executive officer.
The authority said it would soon begin a nationwide search for a permanent chief executive.
